observed_behavior: Customer sell-through rows stored reported_soh but no expected position or gap. Every row date was moved to its Monday and typed weekly, so two days in one week shared a source key and the last won. A file with units and no on-hand loaded silently. In transit and on order were not read. The distributor side already had a derived-stock flag with a 10 percent band.

preservation.cst-fact-rows: kept: fact_customer_sellthrough rows, units and reported on-hand unchanged (1823 rows, 6159 units, 28812 on-hand on cip)
preservation.cst-read-models: kept: weekly/monthly read models; legacy rows keep NULL grain and are read by period_type
preservation.distributor-derived-stock: kept: distributor derived stock and its 10 percent band untouched
